title: Post-tape fragment about where someone lived
summary: A speaker explains where she lived next to the Tio house on St. Philip.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Where the lock is, is where I was living, right next to that single lock. That's where I was living. Somebody I started taking down the tape ran out. My sister lost her last one day. She was living in 2112 St. Philip. That double house right next to that lock. Louis T.O. Brother of Marissa.
